page.seoTitle: Adult Dyslexia & Study Skills Support | Northampton
page.intro:
Dyslexia and other Specific Learning Difficulties do not stop at the school gate. Many adults reach university, a professional qualification or a demanding job before the gap between their ability and their written work becomes a problem, and many have never been assessed.

I offer one-to-one support for adults who are studying or in work: study skills, organisation, planning and managing time, and strategies for reading, writing and remembering information. Sessions are tailored to what you actually need to do: an essay, an exam, a report for your manager.

### Not yet assessed?

If you have never had a diagnostic assessment, that is usually the right first step. A [full diagnostic assessment](/services/dyslexia-diagnostic-assessment/) gives you a clear understanding of your profile and, for university students, is the evidence needed to apply for **Disabled Students' Allowance (DSA)**, which can fund specialist study-skills support, equipment and software. For people in work, the report supports a request for reasonable adjustments from an employer.
page.metaDescription: One-to-one study skills and workplace support for adults with dyslexia and SpLD near Northampton and Wellingborough. Diagnostic assessments for DSA applications also available.
